address:

description:
Henry S. West Laboratory School is an "A"-rated K-8 public magnet and experimental school in Coral Gables that partners with the University of Miami's School of Education. This multi-million-dollar project renovated, expanded, and modernized the campus, adding new classrooms and a science building.

The broader scope included HVAC upgrades to classroom unit ventilators, selective reroofing with additional covered walkways, an upgraded fire alarm system, renovated group and individual restrooms, and repairs to plumbing and sewer components. Crews also upgraded security and PA systems, replaced windows throughout the campus, repainted selectively inside and out, and recoated and restriped the employee parking lot.
